Resolves #21454

🌿 *Lists & Galleries can no longer greet a visitor with a delta counter at zero, a star button and a pandemic frozen in 2020.*

The four cards the group publishes now show their components. The portrait gallery and helix keep their DeltaUpdates counter, star button and sorting guard (restored at `8c7716b866` after the operator's review: a partly rendered store does not animate its sorting); the Navigation Concept label renders its markup and the gallery's panel fits a phone.

Evidence: L3 (catalog and capture specs in CI; scripted live checks and four captured covers) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-6). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: neither country page references `disease.sh` or the COVID snapshot. The gallery and the helix keep their counter, star button and `logDeltaUpdates` checkbox after the operator's review (`8c7716b866`). |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: the gallery's Navigation Concept renders a bold heading over a paragraph, no tag visible. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: the helix's sort buttons are disabled at its default 300 of 600 items and enabled at 600, where Sort by Firstname now sorts by first name (it sorted by last name: the first sorter is the primary one); the gallery's stay disabled. |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: both country pages load the 217 records of `examples/grid/countries/data/countries.json`, India first; 0 of 40 rendered gallery items overflow their card; both attributions name the World Bank (CC BY 4.0) and circle-flags (MIT). No console errors. |
| AC-5 | Outside-CI: at 390 × 844 the gallery's controls take half the width with every label on top, and no input, label or button extends past the panel (a DOM check returned none); the country gallery and both helices follow the same rules. In `multiWindowCoronaGallery` (a native Playwright popup run at 52dc457e9d) the panel measures 260 px of 1280 on the page, 260 of 260 in its popup (`max-width: none`), and 260 capped at 50 % again after the popup closes; 195 px at 390. |
| AC-6 | CI-covered: `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` validates the four new recipes; `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` and `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` keep their counts (four `lists` cards published before and after). Outside-CI: the four covers, taken by those recipes, in neomjs/pages#127. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **Directories and ids keep their names** (`coronaGallery`, `coronaHelix`, `covid-gallery`, `covid-helix`): a rename moves class names, CSS paths, the theme map, SEO paths, recipes and the imports of `multiWindowCoronaGallery`, churn this close to the cut; titles, records and SEO entries say Country.
- **`multiWindowCoronaGallery`** extends the country gallery, so its record's name and scope, its page title and its SEO title follow the data; its cover stays with #21358 (fork sent to its owner).
- **Sort directions:** Country reads A to Z, every figure largest first.
- **The country gallery's 50 % cap lives in its stylesheet** (`.neo-gallery-viewport > .neo-controls-panel`, `CountryGallery.css`), not on the panel: the multi-window gallery moves that panel into a popup, which keeps it full width (Euclid's review).
- **The portrait gallery's card is titled Gallery**, after #21140's visitor-facing titles.
- **Item labels are short** (People, Life, Online; 1.46B, $3.96T): the long ones pushed the right column out of a 340-px card.
